headings: RED ZARA TEMPTATION & VANILLE EXTRAIT DE PARFUM

jsonld_raw.name: RED ZARA TEMPTATION & VANILLE EXTRAIT DE PARFUM 50ML (1.7 FL. OZ).
jsonld_raw.description:
RED ZARA TEMPTATION & VANILLE EXTRAIT DE PARFUM 50ML (1.7 FL. OZ). A highly concentrated extrait de parfum that reinterprets the signature Red Zara Temptation accord through the richness of vanilla. Bitter orange illuminates the opening, while Venezuelan tonka absolute introduces a creamy and balsamic texture. In the base, Madagascar Orpur vanilla absolute unfolds a warm and gourmand depth that intensifies the amber facet of the composition.

Amber Gourmand | Creamy, opulent, and addictive
